subject: FINDING c6t-rca-opus: why C6u compiles at all on device = the pack has NONE of the draw-time variants (replay mali pass no_pipeline=481/481); key predictor uses the record's plan (m2v) not the replay's (air)
body: build/pipeline-pack-c6u/replay.log: 'REPLAY MALI SUMMARY records=481 compiled_or_refused=0 no_pipeline=481'. pipeline_replay_host_test.inc tegu_replay_mali matches a mali record to its pipeline by the m2v SPIR-V sha (vsha/fsha via tegu_pc_spirv_hook); under the AIR plan the pipeline modules are facts modules (vs=20/36 B, fs=68-120 B), so nothing matches and no exact variant (TPC-MALI-1 entry=12, AIR options + airKey) is packed: every exact variant compiles on device at first draw (TEGU_PSO_MISS mali entry=12). Device cost per compile in normal windows 49-247 ms (host 2-12 ms, i.e. ~20x: low-clock cores); the 8647/7621/2637 ms outliers happen in the windows where SpringBoard launches/aborts (both processes slow at the same moment => system contention, not shader content: host replays all 234 CA records exact/runtime-spec/no-constants <=12 ms). Oracle: pipeline_corpus Record.key uses plan from the record (C6t corpus has no plan=air) -> TPC-AIR-1, while the replay frontend creates generic pipelines with TPC-AIRPLAN-1 -> 367/367 'mismatch' (the 234 AIR entries packed are correct; only the prediction is wrong). CLAIM: pipeline_replay_host_test.inc (mali pass: map records to pipelines via an m2v-plan pass, compile the variants through the AIR pipeline's own context = the device's entry=12 keys), metal/tegu/pipeline_corpus.py + tools/build_pipeline_pack.py (predict with the replay's plan), plus thread-CPU ms in TEGU_PSO_MISS (pipeline_cache_frontend.inc 1 line) to split contention from compute on the next device run. a34aeb58: object if you are in these files.
